7.4 Message Forwarding
[SWS_V2xGn_20266]
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_00010, SRS_V2X_00279
⌈The V2xGn module shall only support Area forwarding algorithms specified in [9]
Annex E.3.⌋
[SWS_V2xGn_20267]
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_00010
⌈When forwarding packets, the V2xGn module shall use the DCC profile DP3 as de-
fined in [19].⌋
[SWS_V2xGn_20169]
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_00010
⌈The V2xGn module shall check the distance from the sender position - in the security
envelope, if available - and forward only messages with a distance from the sender of
equal or less than 6 km.⌋
